reconcile.note: Gill limits Exodus 29:36's daily bullock to the seven days of priestly consecration, leaving Numbers 28's two daily lambs as the ongoing perpetual offering.

sides.snippet: Every day shall you offer the bull of sin-offering for atonement
sides.verseText: Every day shall you offer the bull of sin-offering for atonement: and you shall cleanse the altar, when you make atonement for it; and you shall anoint it, to sanctify it.

sides.snippet: he-lambs a year old without blemish, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
sides.verseText: You shall tell them, This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to Yahweh: he-lambs a year old without blemish, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
